verdict.rationale: Whether a feature-flag and experimentation SaaS publishes its source (platform or SDKs) under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code availability, public repositories, or a license. The SDK, CLI, OpenAPI spec and docs-MCP items describe interfaces and documentation, not open source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
